summary: A Yes vote authorizes Temecula Valley Unified School District to issue $215 million in bonds for school facilities, repaid by a property tax estimated at $20 per $100,000 of assessed value.

tax.text: The campaign supports a $215 million bond costing $20 per $100,000 of assessed home value to repair and upgrade Temecula schools.
tax.quote: Measure S will generate $215 million at $20 per $100,000 of the assessed home value to provide locally controlled funding to repair and upgrade Temecula Schools.

schools.text: The campaign says all Measure S funding would be reserved for Temecula schools.
schools.quote: Yes. All Measure S funding can only be used to support Temecula schools. No funds can be taken by the State or used for any other purpose.

tax.text: The No position opposes Measure S, which would levy an annual property tax to repay $215 million in school bonds.
tax.quote: authorizing $215,000,000 in bonds at legal interest rates, levying approximately $20 per $100,000 assessed value (averaging $13,000,000) annually
